/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
text = \"\"\"The proposed update would extend the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A twenty-four-hour benchmark found eighteen percent fewer origin requests, and that reduction is operationally promising. Yet the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence, so the encouraging result and the unmeasured outcome remain in tension. I recommend approving only a canary deployment, with stale-read telemetry required before any broader rollout. The benchmark therefore provides a positive operational signal within a clearly bounded record, while the decision remains correspondingly narrow and conditional on collecting the missing telemetry. In short, the evidence supports a limited experiment, but it does not support a broad rollout.\"\"\"
print(len(text.split()))
